1: ## 1. Infrastructure Setup
2: 
3: - [ ] 1.1 Add Weaviate service to `docker-compose.yml` with exposed HTTP (8080) and gRPC (50051) ports and persistent volume mapping.
4: - [ ] 1.2 Add `weaviate-client`, `@huggingface/transformers`, and `langfuse` backend dependencies to `package.json`.
5: - [ ] 1.3 Update environment config and Zod schemas in `src/shared/schemas.ts` to support Weaviate connectivity and Langfuse tracing environment variables (`LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY`, `LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY`, `LANGFUSE_HOST`).
6: 
7: ## 2. Local Embedding & Search client Core
8: 
9: - [ ] 2.1 Implement purely offline text embedding generation inside `src/server/ai/embeddings.ts` using `@huggingface/transformers` (`all-MiniLM-L6-v2`).
10: - [ ] 2.2 Establish Weaviate database client creation and schema class initializations inside `src/server/ai/weaviate.ts`.
11: - [ ] 2.3 Create startup reconciliation sync script (`src/server/ai/sync.ts`) to backfill Weaviate with all current notes from `notes.json`.
12: 
13: ## 3. Background Sync & Ingest Pipeline
14: 
15: - [ ] 3.1 Create recursive markdown chunking utility inside `src/server/ai/chunker.ts` to split notes cleanly around markdown headers.
16: - [ ] 3.2 Add background event handlers listening to Express `storeEvents` inside `listeners.ts` to chunk, embed, and index notes on `note:created` and `note:updated`.
17: - [ ] 3.3 Add delete event listener to purge associated note chunks in Weaviate on `note:deleted`.
18: 
19: ## 4. Streaming RAG Chat Endpoint & Dual-Loop LLMOps
20: 
21: - [ ] 4.1 Implement semantic search retrieval utility inside Weaviate integration to perform cosine-similarity lookups with hybrid tag pre-filters.
22: - [ ] 4.2 Create `POST /api/chat` route in `src/server/api.ts` utilizing Vercel AI SDK to stream context-grounded prompt answers containing markdown citations.
23: - [ ] 4.3 Set up Promptfoo configuration (`promptfooconfig.yaml`) and seed local Golden Datasets inside `tests/promptfoo/` to execute pre-release regression assertions offline.
24: - [ ] 4.4 Integrate Langfuse SDK tracing with Vercel AI SDK streaming calls to export runtime spans to the local Langfuse container for post-release auditing.
25: - [ ] 4.5 Implement a data flywheel CLI script (`scripts/enrich-evals.ts`) to extract low-score or flagged Langfuse production traces and append them directly to the local Promptfoo Golden Dataset.
26: 
27: ## 5. Front-End Omnibox & Conversational UI
28: 
29: - [ ] 5.1 Extend Zustand store `useNoteStore.ts` with chat state, message collections, streaming handler, and toggle flags.
30: - [ ] 5.2 Build sliding drawer `ChatPanel.tsx` interface displaying real-time streaming answers and collapsible citations.
31: - [ ] 5.3 Implement dynamic dual-mode search Omnibox interface allowing users to toggle between keyword filtering and chat prompts on Enter/click.
32: - [ ] 5.4 Style custom interactive TipTap link badges mapping cited notes directly to active note editor triggers.

1: ## Context
2: 
3: Rook Notes is a minimal, local, markdown-based note-taking application operating entirely on a local JSON file (`data/notes.json`) inside a Docker container. We want to implement a fully local, private, and highly interactive "Chat with my Vault" conversational retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) feature. This design outlines the infrastructure, embedding pipeline, derived index sync, and dual-mode UI details.
4: 
5: ## Goals / Non-Goals
6: 
7: **Goals:**
8: - Provide a robust, 100% offline semantic search and RAG capability over notes.
9: - Sync the database state (`notes.json`) with the search index in a performant, non-blocking manner.
10: - Deliver an elegant, dual-mode search/chat interface (Omnibox) with cited sources mapped back to note editors.
11: - Build premium observability and automated quality assurance using Langfuse tracing and LLM-as-a-judge evaluators.
12: 
13: **Non-Goals:**
14: - Do not migrate primary note storage away from `notes.json` (keep Weaviate strictly as a derived index).
15: - Do not allow the AI to directly edit, modify, or delete note contents.
16: - Do not make external API requests for text embeddings (keep vectors on-device).
17: 
18: ## Decisions
19: 
20: ### 1. Vector Database: Weaviate (Local Docker Container)
21: - **Rationale**: Weaviate provides excellent performance, an extremely rich query API supporting structured filtering + vector search (hybrid search), and a modern Node.js v4 SDK. By using Docker-hosted Weaviate, we keep the stack unified, scalable, and isolated.
22: - **Alternatives Considered**: 
23:   - *Pinecone (Cloud)*: Rejected to guarantee offline functionality and strict privacy constraints.
24:   - *SQLite-VSS / PGVector*: Rejected due to complex multi-platform build toolchains and Docker setup constraints inside our existing Node environments.
25: 
26: ### 2. Embedding Model: `@huggingface/transformers` (`all-MiniLM-L6-v2`)
27: - **Rationale**: Running embeddings locally in Node is highly performant with the `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` ONNX model. At ~90MB, it runs fast even on raw CPUs, is fully offline, has zero cost, and generates compact 384-dimension vectors that minimize Weaviate memory overhead.
28: - **Alternatives Considered**: 
29:   - *Google Gemini text-embedding-004 (API)*: Rejected because it breaks offline-first guarantees and introduces network API dependencies.
30: 
31: ### 3. Sync & Derived Index Strategy: Event-Driven + Boot Reconciliation
32: - **Rationale**: When note contents change, the backend emits `storeEvents` internally. A background indexer listens to these events, chunks the note, generates embeddings, and upserts them to Weaviate asynchronously (non-blocking). On Express API startup, a reconciliation routine scans `notes.json` and updates any missing or outdated vectors.
33: - **Alternatives Considered**:
34:   - *Synchronous Save-blocking Indexing*: Rejected because embedding generation would block user note saving, increasing perceived latency.
35: 
36: ### 4. Streaming & RAG Endpoint: Dedicated POST `/api/chat` Route
37: - **Rationale**: Utilizes the Vercel AI SDK `streamText` function returning standard Data Stream Protocol chunks. This enables seamless binding to React's `useChat` hook, automatically managing message context and token streams.
38: - **Alternatives Considered**:
39:   - *SSE Broadcast over /api/events*: Rejected to isolate transient chat token chunks from global client sync events.
40: 
41: ### 5. AI Quality & Observability: Dual-Loop LLMOps Quality Framework (Promptfoo + Langfuse)
42: - **Rationale**: Production AI products require both pre-release guardrails and post-release monitoring. We implement a **Dual-Loop LLMOps Quality Framework** to seamlessly couple both environments locally:
43:   1. **Pre-Release Loop (The Guardrails / CI/CD)**: We use **Promptfoo** to execute offline regression tests against a local Golden Dataset (YAML) before any code or prompt changes are merged, asserting strict thresholds on token limits, output structures, and similarity.
44:   2. **Post-Release Loop (The Monitor / APM)**: We instrument the active backend using self-hosted **Langfuse** running inside our local Docker Compose. Every client chat session is traced in detail (embedding calculations, Weaviate retrieval scores, and Gemini text generation spans) with Vercel AI SDK's simplified Langfuse/OTel integration.
45:   3. **The Data Flywheel**: When users interact with the app, Langfuse captures live traces. Failed user queries (e.g. low-score sessions, thumbs-down feedback) are exported and added directly to the Promptfoo Golden Dataset, continually hardening the pre-release test suite.
46: 
47: ```text
48:   +------------------------------------------------------------------+
49:   |              1. PRE-RELEASE EVAL LOOP (Promptfoo)                |
50:   |     Local Golden Dataset (QA Pairs) -> Offline Assertions        |
51:   +----------------────────────────┬────────────────────────────────-+
52:                                    |
53:                                    | (Build passes -> Deploy)
54:                                    ▼
55:   +------------------------------------------------------------------+
56:   |              2. POST-RELEASE TRACING LOOP (Langfuse)             |
57:   |   Live user queries -> Local Langfuse container -> Trace Portal  |
58:   +----------------────────────────┬────────────────────────────────-+
59:                                    |
60:                                    | (Identify low-score/failed runs)
61:                                    ▼
62:   +------------------------------------------------------------------+
63:   |             3. CONVERSATIONAL AUDIT & FLYWHEEL                   |
64:   |   Export user failure logs to enrich Promptfoo Golden Dataset    |
65:   +------------------------------------------------------------------+
66: ```
67: - **Alternatives Considered**:
68:   - *Console Logging*: Rejected because it does not scale to structured nested trace tree analysis, nor does it support automated pre-merge evaluation metrics.
69:   - *SaaS-Only Tracing (LangSmith)*: Rejected because a self-hosted Langfuse container keeps all user traces completely local, secure, and 100% private.
70: 
71: ## Risks / Trade-offs
72: 
73: - **[Risk] Container Resource Consumption** → **Mitigation**: Constrain the local Weaviate and Langfuse container memory allocations in `docker-compose.yml` and use the ultra-lightweight `MiniLM` model instead of heavier BERT embeddings.
74: - **[Risk] Sync Inconsistencies** → **Mitigation**: A lightweight startup checker maps all `notes.json` entries to Weaviate, backfilling any gaps or missing values on boot.
75: - **[Risk] Telemetry Overhead & Network Leaks** → **Mitigation**: Allow complete Opt-Out of tracing by setting `LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=""` in the `.env` configuration. The core search and local RAG code paths will continue to function fully offline.
